fields.description: Issue includes reports and commentary on an assault on the paper’s publisher and related legal proceedings; debate over a proposed Miami sales tax and alternative revenue ideas; discussion of horse-race “books” and their closure’s effects on employment, municipal revenue, and poverty; local government and courthouse/City Hall-related coverage; a campaign with the Miami Police Department to reduce traffic accidents as schools reopen; updates on a Miami telephone rate case; and community/society items and promotions including a working-girl beauty contest (Mark Store) and racing-tip advertisements.
